def reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation):
    """
    Reverses the order of elements and their corresponding punctuation marks.

    Args:
        elements (list): List of string elements to be reversed.
        punctuation (list): List of punctuation marks corresponding to each element.

    Returns:
        tuple: A tuple containing two lists — (reversed_elements, reversed_punctuation).

    Example:
        >>> reverse_list_elements(["Hello", "world"], ["", "!"])
        (["world", "Hello"], ["!", ""])
    """
    new_elements = elements[::-1]
    new_punctuation = punctuation[::-1]
    return (new_elements, new_punctuation)
